title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Numbers 35: the cities of the Levites, the cities of refuge and the laws about murder.

questions.text: What were the children of Israel to give the Levites out of their inheritance?
questions.explanation: They were to give the Levites cities to dwell in, with pasture lands around the cities.

answers.text: A tenth of all the plunder
A whole territory beyond the Jordan
Cities to dwell in, with pasture lands

questions.text: How far outward from the city wall did the pasture lands of the Levites' cities reach?
questions.explanation: The pasture lands were to be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

questions.text: How many cities in all were the Levites to receive?
questions.explanation: All the cities given to the Levites were to be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

questions.text: Who could flee to a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: The cities of refuge were for the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly.

answers.text: Someone who had stolen from the sanctuary
Someone who killed a person unwittingly
Someone who had broken a vow to Yahweh
Someone who could not pay a debt

questions.text: How were the six cities of refuge divided?
questions.explanation: Three cities were to be given beyond the Jordan and three cities in the land of Canaan.

answers.text: All six in the land of Canaan
Three beyond the Jordan and three in Canaan
Two beyond the Jordan and four in Canaan

questions.text: Besides the children of Israel, who could use the cities of refuge?
questions.explanation: The six cities were for refuge for the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the foreigner living among them.

answers.text: Only the priests and the Levites
Only the elders of the tribes
Only the captives taken in war
The stranger and the foreigner among them

questions.text: What was someone called who struck a person with an instrument of iron so that he died?
questions.explanation: If he struck him with an instrument of iron so that he died, he is a murderer and shall surely be put to death.

answers.text: A man slayer who may flee

questions.text: Who was to put the murderer to death?
questions.explanation: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death when he meets him.

questions.text: Until when did the man slayer have to stay in his city of refuge?
questions.explanation: He was to dwell in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

answers.text: Until the avenger of blood died
Until the death of the high priest

questions.text: What does the law say about witnesses when someone is to be put to death?
questions.explanation: The murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses, but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

answers.text: One witness may not testify alone
